name: Greater Defensive Study (Ex)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents, Defensive Study

Benefit(s): Whenever a slayer that selects this talent applies the effects of the defensive study slayer talent to his studied target, he adds twice his studied target bonus to his CMD and as a dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity made by his studied target.
